definitions.explanation: Describes something that is intensely green (vegetation) or blue (sky, water). Almost always used with the particle と.

examples.japanese: ⟦{芝生|しばふ}→芝生：03196_shibafu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{青々|あおあお}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: The lawn is lush and green.

examples.japanese: ⟦{田|た}んぼ→田んぼ：00402_tanbo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{稲|いね}→稲：01820_ine⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{青々|あおあお}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{茂|しげ}っている→茂る：03924_shigeru⟧。
examples.english: The rice plants are growing lush and green in the paddy field.

examples.japanese: ⟦{山|やま}→山：02168_yama⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{木|き}々⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{青々|あおあお}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{茂|しげ}る→茂る：03924_shigeru⟧⟦{季節|きせつ}→季節：01304_kisetsu⟧になった。
examples.english: The season has come when the mountain trees grow lush and green.

examples.japanese: ⟦{雨上|あめあ}がり→雨上がり：14586_ameagari⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{空|そら}→空：02216_sora⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{青々|あおあお}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{広|ひろ}がっていた→広がる：01980_hirogaru⟧。
examples.english: The sky stretched out vividly blue after the rain stopped.

notes:
{青々|あおあお} is a repetitive adverb ({畳語|じょうご}) that intensifies the meaning of ⟦{青|あお}い→青い：00586_aoi⟧.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- Almost always used as {青々|あおあお}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧ + verb
- Can also be used as {青々|あおあお}とした + noun (lush green [noun])

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {青々|あおあお}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{茂|しげ}る→茂る：03924_shigeru⟧ (to grow lush and green)
- {青々|あおあお}とした⟦{芝生|しばふ}→芝生：03196_shibafu⟧ (lush green lawn)
- {青々|あおあお}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{広|ひろ}がる→広がる：01980_hirogaru⟧ (to spread out vividly blue/green)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {赤々|あかあか}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧ (blazing red)
- {白々|しらじら}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧ (pale white)
